integrity: The classification is a finite exact theorem with constructive integer-coefficient certificates and a standalone standard-library verifier. No numerical inference is used to certify root uniqueness. Publication priority and external independent audit are not established.
limitations: Connected simple graphs of order 2 through 5, one perfect vaccination, homogeneous independent bond transmissibility and uniform post-vaccination initial seed only; endpoints 0 and 1 excluded from optimizer-set statements; not a claim about general SIR timing or larger graphs.
title: The five-vertex threshold for transmission-dependent optimal vaccination
